content_zh: 第一章 At the bar, the usually young and elegant girl turned into the most enchanting witch, drinking one glass after another of strong drinks to get herself drunk. Being an orphan is tragic enough, but when she was thirteen years old, the orphanage she was in was inexplicably caught in a fire, so all the memories in her mind were mysteriously frightened away. After living on the street, she was adopted by the underworld Situ family, and she fell in love with the heir of the Situ family, Situ Luotian. According to the plot of a normal fairy tale, the prince and Cinderella should live a happy and happy life. However, a princess comes out halfway and competes with her to steal the prince, turning her fairy tale into an upgraded version of a bloody drama. Yes, the princess and the prince are getting married, so Cinderella can only make a gorgeous exit. Just leave the show, but before she even walked off the stage, she witnessed a passionate tongue kiss between them! nausea! She has already received the admission notice from a top French university and will leave tomorrow, far away from this place that makes him sad. But why is there such a strong reluctance? With a strong force, her petite body crashed into an embrace with the cool scent of mint. However, the next second... "Ouch!" His face was so indifferent that there was no expression, but a trace of bloodthirsty smile slipped across the corner of his mouth. Woman, you are dead! The man lowered his head, and his slender body suddenly tensed up. Damn woman, what's that expression? At this moment, in front of Ye Qianmo was Situ Luotian's face, handsome and elegant. Today, she was wearing such sexy clothes and almost stripped naked in front of him, but he remained unmoved. He just bent down to pick up her clothes and put them on her body. He is not interested in her, but she is unwilling to give in. Apart from family background and background, what good things does that woman have? Ye Qianmo looked at the man in front of her in confusion, "Can I give it to you?" Hearing this, the man raised her chin coldly, with a condescending attitude like a superior king, waiting for everyone's worship and surrender, "Are you sure?" Ye Qianmo nodded immediately and rubbed against his chest like a kitten, "Do you want it?" The soft voice and ambiguous tone are enough to drive any man crazy! The man smiled evilly, picked her up and strode away. The heat in her body became more and more obvious.
